summary: Authored the B2 ('sustained argument and spontaneous interaction') level blueprint against the shared curriculum master and level blueprint template: docs/curriculum/blueprints/b2.md and b2.json. 19 capabilities (13 required, 5 should, 1 optional) across 6 arcs, 20 new pattern groups, 3 proposed semantic types, an 88/67 vocabulary budget, and 4 declared core-engine requirements (discourse-coherence evaluation, register/pragmatic appropriateness as a separate dimension, an honest fallback for open argumentative turns, and meaning-preserved reformulation checking). The first draft used placeholder b1.* prerequisites (LC-BP-B1 had not merged yet); after rebasing on main once LC-BP-B1 landed, every b1.* id was reconciled against the real docs/curriculum/blueprints/b1.md/b1.json, and the reconciliation surfaced genuine overlap between several B1 should/optional capabilities and proposed B2 capabilities (negotiate_a_solution, express_frustration_politely, summarize_what_was_said, recommend_or_warn, talk_about_real_conditions, imagine_a_hypothetical) — each is called out explicitly with the required escalation, not silently duplicated. A full structural LC-AUD-001 cross-level audit is still required before runtime content depends on this document. Design-only: no runtime module imports either file and product availability stays false.
